value.stringValue: Reminder: On Hold Opportunities Past Follow-Up Date

Hi {!$Record.Owner.LastName} {!$Record.Owner.FirstName},


The opportunity in Salesforce has crossed its follow-up date and is still not updated.

Updating Salesforce is mandatory. Repeated delays in updating opportunities are treated as a compliance issue and will impact performance evaluation.

Please update the opportunity immediately with the correct stage or revised follow-up date.

Click here to open the opportunity.

This is a system-triggered compliance alert.

Regards,

Arun
